items.statement: Capex of around INR 5 crores plus for new premises with more than double capacity
items.quote: So roughly around INR 5 crores plus investments what we are targeting in this new premises because all the new machineries and everything is in place.

items.statement: Company initiated equity fundraise of INR2,000 million (INR200 crores) through preferential allotment to drive sustainable growth.
items.quote: Lastly, I would like to share that the company has initiated an equity fundraise of INR2,000 million i.e. INR200 crores through preferential allotment.

items.statement: Preferential issue proceeds of INR200 crores will be used for debt repayment, working capital, and general corporate purposes.
items.quote: From the current use, we have kept it that some percentage will go for a debt reduction, some debt repayment, some percentage will go for the company's working capital business purpose and a certain percentage has been kept as a GCP purpose.
